description: Read or write chrome.storage in a running extension. Start the session with allowControl:true (extension_dev). Set one key per call: there is no bulk-object set.

action.description: get reads a key (or the whole area); set writes a key

browser.description: Session browser; defaults to this project's live session

projectPath.description: Extension project root (needs a live dev session)

value.description: Value to set (any JSON value); required for action=set

name: extension_storage
